reason: A JupyterLab-style IDE workspace centered on file management, multi-format preview and editing, integrated terminals, code execution, diffs, and SSH-based remote development.

summaries.zh: 提供类似 JupyterLab 的文件树、代码与文档编辑、多格式预览、差异查看、终端和 SSH 远程开发工作区。
summaries.en: Provides a JupyterLab-style workspace with file management, code and document editing, multi-format previews, diffs, terminals, and SSH remote development.

capabilities: local and remote file browsing, creation, editing, renaming, copying, downloading, and deletion
local and SSH-based remote terminal and command execution
SSH connections using passwords or keys, including multi-host profiles
preview and editing of Markdown, HTML, images, CSV, Office documents, and logs
execution of Python, Node.js, Bash, and R scripts
